defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 10)
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, the statue has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once the statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 24.

offensiveAbilities.name: Clinging Gloom
offensiveAbilities.description: The statue pulls a creature it has Grabbed into its grasping shadows. The target takes 3d8 Void Damage damage and 1d8 Persistent,void Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cowl of Shadow
offensiveAbilities.description: Shifting shadows cover the statue. If the statue is dealt at least 15 Vitality Damage damage or brought within an area of magical light, the shadows recede, and the statue can't make darkness mote attacks or use Clinging Gloom.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
